title: Monotone Decreasing Values Limit
body_html:
Monotone Decreasing Values Limit

Let $G_n=(S,T,f_n)$ be a family of zero-sum games such that:

  1. $(f_n)$ is a weakly decreasing sequence of uniformly bounded functions $S\times T\to\mathbb R$;
  2. each $f_n$ is upper semicontinuous in the first variable;
  3. each $G_n$ has a value $v_n$;
  4. $S$ is compact.

Let $f=\inf_n f_n$. Then the game $G=(S,T,f)$ has value $$ v=\inf_n v_n, $$ and player 1 has an optimal strategy in $G$.
